units.title: The Mac adoption prompt and the Mac tool reference

decisions.decision: Does the plan need a review unit?
decisions.ruling: No. The plan writes docs only; no runnable line changes.
decisions.rejected: A review unit over a docs-only change.

decisions.decision: Can the 16 plans of the merge run in parallel?
decisions.ruling: No. The 16 plans form one linear chain through requires, because most of them edit sync-engine/repo-sync or sync-engine/setup-sync, and parallel plans conflict there. This plan requires 2026-11-04-docs-design-split.

decisions.decision: What does docs/setup/tools.md hold for each tool?
decisions.ruling: From macos/tools/<tool>/tools.toml and macos/packs.toml: the description, the packs that hold it and whether it is a default there, the stage, depends, each file with its mode, template, format, requires and remove keys, the contributions, the [mise.*] sections by name, and the key of each question with a link to its [questions.<key>] table. The question text stays in tools.toml only.
decisions.rejected: Copy the question text into tools.md (two places for one rule).

decisions.decision: Which command does the adoption prompt give for the first run on a new Mac?
decisions.ruling: On a Mac that has mise and the macos-setup clone, the first run passes the variable inline: MACOS_SETUP_CONFIG_PATH=<path of the macos-setup clone> mise run updateall:configs. Later runs get it from the generated mise env. A new Mac uses the parked change of the macos-setup setup script; the doc says so and names the parked step. Each command is one that the landed code supports.
decisions.rejected: Write a command that no landed code supports; leave the first run open with a GAP.

decisions.ruling: An AI agent that works with the owner of the Mac, as docs/sync/index.md does for a repository. Each owner decision is one question at a time. Each step names the command and its pass condition.
decisions.rejected: A how-to for a person only.

decisions.decision: What is the dotfiles.root note of the migration?
decisions.ruling: A personal file stays in dotfiles/ and gets a [mise.dotfiles] entry in macos.toml. The live model sets the mise setting dotfiles.root to the dotfiles/ folder of the macos-setup clone; the guide tells the owner to keep that setting in [mise.settings] of macos.toml when a personal file uses a source path relative to it. The unit checks the [dotfiles] section and dotfiles.root in the mise docs with Context7 before it writes the note.
decisions.rejected: Absolute source paths in every [mise.dotfiles] entry with no note.

decisions.decision: Which names do the Mac docs have?
decisions.ruling: docs/setup/index.md, docs/setup/migrate-dotfiles.md and docs/setup/tools.md. The later "Mac docs" ruling wins over the older placement bullet, which names sync.md and tool-reference.md.

decisions.decision: What does a friend without read access to virajp/macos-setup do in the first step?
decisions.ruling: The friend skips the git merge-base step: the diff of the scratch-HOME comparison is then the list of changes. With access, the agent uses merge-base first.
decisions.rejected: Stop the migration without access to virajp/macos-setup.

decisions.decision: Which command makes the macos-setup repo private?
decisions.ruling: mise x gh@latest -- gh repo edit <owner>/<repo> --visibility private --accept-visibility-change-consequences. It names the repo and runs through mise.
decisions.rejected: gh repo edit without the repo name or outside mise.

decisions.decision: Which heading does a tool section of docs/setup/tools.md have?
decisions.rejected: A level-2 heading, or the tool name without a code span.

gaps.text: D4's first-run command assumes the task updateall:configs exists, but the task ships only through the sync, so a Mac with mise and the clone has no such task · docs/setup/index.md step 5 tests the task file for the Synced from bootstrap header: with it, the dry run; an old task or a plain file at tasks/updateall goes to migrate-dotfiles.md with no run; a missing task is rendered with gomplate into ~/.config/mise/tasks/updateall/configs/_default; then the D4 command runs. Not run against a real clone.

The plan does not say what the agent does on a new Mac while the setup script of macos-setup is still the old one · The doc tells the agent not to run it, because it installs the dotfiles/ model, and to tell the owner the step is parked and stop.

The Notes part of macos-setup docs/tool-reference.md (packages, shells and init stage, secrets, identity, Claude Code, maintenance) is not in the plan's list for docs/setup/tools.md · Not carried over; that prose is in no bootstrap doc unless a later plan moves it.
The update path does not cover an empty bootstrap_commit · No sync completed, so the agent does steps 2 to 6 of the first adoption.
The plan says nothing about whether macos.toml may hold a secret · A Rules line forbids secrets in it, because the owner commits the file.

D4 and the Facts assume mise run updateall:configs works on a Mac with mise and the clone, but the live model has no such task · The guide uses the direct form of the sync (bash <bootstrap>/macos/tools/macos-setup/.config/mise/tasks/updateall/configs/sync with SYNC_ENGINE_CLONE) only in steps 6 and 8, where the task cannot exist; the first real run, step 10, is the D4 command after the render in step 5 of docs/setup/index.md.

D6 says to keep dotfiles.root when a source path is relative to it, but the mise docs (Context7, v2026.11.0) say a relative source starts at the folder of the declaring config file, and dotfiles.root applies only when source is omitted · The note keeps dotfiles.root in [mise.settings] of macos.toml, and says how the path resolves; the owner ratifies the difference from D6.
The plan says 13 files belong to no tool, but today's tracked dotfiles/ has 4 against macos/tools/ · The count is out of date, so the guide gives a list command and no number.
The plan does not cover a friend's repo that is a fork, where GitHub can refuse the visibility change · The agent stops and shows the owner the message, and the owner decides.

These steps of the guide were not run: the gh commands of step 5, git push, a real mise bootstrap, and a real HOME · The D4 path was simulated in a scratch HOME with a link into a scratch clone, a local SYNC_ENGINE_URL and the sample macos.toml: render, dry run exit 0 with 0 failed, real run exit 4, then exit 0, bootstrap_commit written.

U2 Edits name only the 19 fragments and the obsolete files for deletion, but a simulation showed the plain file dotfiles/.config/mise/tasks/updateall makes 3 targets fail, because the sync needs a folder at that path · Step 9 also deletes that file, and step 3 leaves it out of the classification of the owner.

The plan says to run vwf:docs-sync over the full branch delta, but that skill ends at its step 1 for a scope of only human-doc edits · No surveyor ran; U3 applied the handed DOCS FALSIFIED lines and checked CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/sync and docs/design with a grep.

The lead of Where the rules are in CLAUDE.md still says each rule of the sync has one place in docs/design/, and the list now also names docs/setup/ files · The plan asks only for the lines, so the lead stays: the Mac docs are prompts and a reference, not sync rules.
